summary.business_type: Freelance web developer, service-area business (Debrecen, Hungary)
top_findings: New homepage content (homeHu) written but never imported; /hu still shows generic copy with no Debrecen
IT üzemeltetés price conflict: 90 000-180 000 Ft on homepage and schema vs 9 999 Ft/hó on the service page
No testimonials, reviews, headshot or case study with numbers
/hu/it-uzemeltetes targets office-IT searches with website-hosting content
quick_wins: Add Debrecen to /hu/webshop-keszites title and H1
Update /hu/blog meta description (removed Supabase/React Native posts)
Ask hoodini.hu for a 'Készítette: Csuka Viktor' footer link

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Real sitemap lastmod dates
Security headers present
Self-canonicals and reciprocal hreflang with x-default
Server-rendered pages
Real 404s; removed posts 301 to blog index

findings.title: 404 page has two robots tags and homepage title
findings.description: Layout robots tag plus noindex; inherits homepage metadata.
findings.recommendation: Export metadata with robots index:false and its own title from src/app/[lang]/not-found.tsx.

findings.title: Apex domain takes two redirects
findings.description: csukaviktor.com 301 -> www, then 308 -> /hu.
findings.recommendation: Point the apex directly to https://www.csukaviktor.com/hu.

findings.title: HSTS without includeSubDomains/preload; no CSP
findings.description: Strict-Transport-Security max-age only; no Content-Security-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Extend HSTS and add a report-only CSP in next.config.ts.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Unverifiable blog posts removed
Service pages expanded to 512-598 unique words with audience, process, prices, Debrecen section and FAQs
Phone number on every page

findings.title: IT üzemeltetés price conflict
findings.description: Homepage and JSON-LD show 90 000-180 000 Ft; /hu/it-uzemeltetes shows 9 999 Ft/hó-tól.
findings.recommendation: Unify prices across homepage, schema and service page.

findings.title: Unbacked claims
findings.description: '10+ Elégedett ügyfél' with one visible client project; '24/7 rendszer-monitoring' from a solo freelancer.
findings.recommendation: Remove or substantiate.

findings.title: No social proof
findings.description: No testimonials, reviews or headshot; Hoodini reference is one unlinked sentence and the results placeholder is unfilled.
findings.recommendation: Add named testimonials, a Hoodini case study with numbers and a headshot.

findings.title: Stale developer-focused blog
findings.description: One ~300-word post from 2026-02-10 labelled 8 minutes; H1 says Next.js 14.
findings.recommendation: Publish buyer-intent posts linked to service pages.

findings.title: Spotify clone still in projects
findings.description: Tutorial-style project in a commercial portfolio.
findings.recommendation: Replace with client work or a business demo.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles 53-65 chars, service descriptions 145-160
One H1 per page, clean H2/H3
Keyword anchors from homepage to all service pages
HU blog post links to webshop page
Meta keywords removed

findings.title: Homepage content not wired in
findings.description: homeHu (content-hu.ts:22) has a Debrecen title/H1, service cards and FAQ but nothing imports it.
findings.recommendation: Render homeHu from src/app/[lang]/page.tsx.

findings.title: Homepage services section shows only the IT block
findings.description: Core services appear as bare arrow links without H3, description or price.
findings.recommendation: Fixed by rendering homeHu.

findings.title: Thin blog index
findings.description: /hu/blog ~54 words; title 'Blog | Csuka Viktor'; description mentions removed posts.
findings.recommendation: Write an intro and a keyword title/description.

findings.title: Same OG image on every page; EN has no service path
findings.description: Single og-image.jpg; /en has no services.
findings.recommendation: Per-page opengraph-image.tsx; EN services page if targeting non-HU clients.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid site-wide graph (WebSite, Person, ProfessionalService) on all pages, confirmed in live HTML
Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList on service pages; BlogPosting on posts
Address locality, telephone, priceRange, areaServed added

findings.title: Schema images use the OG banner
findings.description: Person, ProfessionalService and BlogPosting images are the 1200x630 banner.
findings.recommendation: Square headshot for Person; per-post images.

findings.title: ProfessionalService lacks sameAs, geo, logo, GBP link
findings.description: sameAs exists only on Person.
findings.recommendation: Add sameAs (incl. GBP), hasMap, geo (city centre), logo.

findings.title: priceRange not a range and inconsistent
findings.description: '19 999 Ft-tól' vs catalog minimum 90 000 Ft.
findings.recommendation: Derive from the real catalog after unifying prices.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop Lighthouse 100
CLS 0 everywhere
TTFB 20-70 ms
gtag deferred, particles lazy and skipped on mobile, local images, JS 215 -> 163 KB

findings.title: Mobile LCP 2.7-3.1 s (lab)
findings.description: Mostly element render delay (~830 ms on /hu).
findings.recommendation: Remove animate-fade-up from above-the-fold text; consider experimental.inlineCss.

findings.title: Mobile TBT 200-410 ms
findings.description: 160-172 KB JS even on the static blog post; largest chunk 71 KB.
findings.recommendation: Dynamic-import the contact form; bundle-analyze large chunks.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed
Server-rendered content
Question-style H2s with direct answers on service pages
Accessibility tree fully named except the contact form

findings.title: No About/entity page; few third-party mentions
findings.description: Only own profiles and companywall.hu; LinkedIn says Frontend, site says Full-Stack; a same-name tattoo artist appears in results.
findings.recommendation: Add /hu/rolam, align profile headlines, extend sameAs, build directory listings.

findings.title: Contact form not agent-readable
findings.description: Labels lack htmlFor, inputs lack id/name/autoComplete; status messages lack aria-live.
findings.recommendation: Fix in ContactSection.tsx.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Optional public/llms.txt.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Local project screenshots via next/image with sizes, srcset, AVIF/WebP
Descriptive localized alt text

findings.title: No headshot; service pages have zero images
findings.description: No personal photo; 0 on service pages.
findings.recommendation: Add headshot and project screenshots/mockups.

findings.title: Oversized source JPGs
findings.description: hoodini.jpg 490 KB, kozos.jpg 203 KB.
findings.recommendation: Convert to ~1280px WebP.

supplementary.backlinks: Not measured (no Moz/Bing keys; Common Crawl timed out). hoodini.hu does not link back.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Wire homeHu into the HU homepage and unify IT prices in page and schema
Remove or substantiate '10+ ügyfél' and '24/7 monitoring'
Fix typo, blog index description, Next.js 14 H1
Add Debrecen to webshop-keszites title and H1

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Create Google Business Profile and request reviews; add to sameAs/hasMap
Decide it-uzemeltetes direction (rename + 301 or real office-IT offer)
Package tables and screenshots on service pages
Contact form accessibility and extra fields; hero CTA order
Remove above-the-fold fade animation; dynamic-import contact form

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: 3-4 buyer-intent blog posts linked to service pages
Hungarian directory listings with identical NAP; client-site credits
Per-page OG images, schema images, LinkedIn headline alignment

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; track the 4 money keywords
Vercel Speed Insights field data monthly
Re-run with PageSpeed and Moz API keys
